descriptionChirho: To be beneficial, profitable, or expedient; used impersonally to express what is better or advantageous for someone (Matt 5:29-30, 18:6, 19:10; John 11:50, 16:7, 18:14; 1 Cor 6:12, 7:35, 10:23, 10:33, 12:7; 2 Cor 8:10, 12:1; Acts 20:20; Heb 12:10)
To carry or bring together into one place, the literal spatial sense of the compound verb (Acts 19:19, of people gathering their books of magic)
